name: Programmer & designer
description: Give Programmer a task, review the code with Designer, and apply feedback for three rounds.
initial_task: Write a small C program that prints a greeting. Review its design and improve it using the designer's feedback.

agents.name: Programmer
agents.role: You are a C programmer. Return a complete C program in a fenced code block.

agents.name: Designer
agents.role: Review the C program against the original task. Suggest concrete design improvements for the programmer to apply.
